_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gold-miner signals with Newmont's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Newmont is one of the world’s largest gold producers and is the only gold company included in the S&P 500 Index and Fortune 500.' 'Our business is dependent on the prices of gold and copper, which fluctuate on a daily basis and are affected by numerous factors beyond our control.' 'A substantial or extended decline in gold or copper prices would have a material adverse effect on Newmont.' (the FY2014 10-K's own words; it does not call the business cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a gold miner on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names a miner), so the watch list is empty; Newmont holds no oil, gas or coal reserves and no refining, so ENERGY_TRANSITION is read as out of scope, and the 10-K's own climate words are a cost, not a stranded reserve: 'Regulations and pending legislation governing issues involving climate change could result in increased operating costs which could have a material adverse effect on our business.' (the FY2014 10-K's risk factor) (text only)

(the FY2014 10-K's own words; it does not call the business cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a gold miner on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names a miner), so the watch list is empty; Newmont holds no oil, gas or coal reserves and no refining, so ENERGY_TRANSITION is read as out of scope, and the 10-K's own climate words are a cost, not a stranded reserve: 'Regulations and pending legislation governing issues involving climate change could result in increased operating costs which could have a material adverse effect on our business.' (the FY2014 10-K's risk factor) (text only). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.40x; +80% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.33; conservative 2yr -6%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14 ex-FY07 ex-FY11 ex-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.2%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY07 ex-FY11 ex-FY13 median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.2%/yr (FY05-FY14 ex-FY07 ex-FY11 ex-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +59.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14 ex-FY07 ex-FY11 ex-FY13, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEM (retrospective, 2016-02-12) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.40x (47.1% downside to Bear $13.64 / +33.7% upside to Bull $34.46) | Adj composite 2.71 vs market 2.38: gap +0.33 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +80% above the EPP floor $14.30 (13x FY15E $1.10) | Conservative 2-yr case: -6.2% total (-3.1%/yr) | At 23.4x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $34.09 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +16.4% YoY in Q3 2015, forward revenues +16.4% (Q3 2015 revenue growth (no revenue guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
